tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Working with Watercolour and Acrylic

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring working with watercolour and acrylic. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to working with watercolour and acrylic, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with working with watercolour and acrylic. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with working with watercolour and acrylic. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Working with Watercolour and Acrylic

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Create a series of paint experiments showing at least four different watercolour or acrylic techniques. Annotate each sample explaining the process, its effect and when you might use it. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate a wide RANGE of techniques; show technical control and understanding; annotate with precise specialist vocabulary; evaluate which techniques are most effective for different purposes; connect technique choices to artists studied. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
